question: What is the title of Arundhati Roy’s latest book, released in September 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mother Mary Comes to Me**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The world-renowned Indian author **Arundhati Roy** announced her highly anticipated memoir titled **Mother Mary Comes to Me**, which is scheduled for a global release in **September 2025**.
 
• This book represents a significant milestone in her literary career as it is her **first memoir**, providing a personal narrative that spans her childhood in **Kerala** to her journey as a public intellectual. ***Hence, the correct answer is Mother Mary Comes to Me.***
 
• The title of the memoir is famously inspired by a lyric from the **Beatles**' iconic song "**Let It Be**," reflecting the cultural and personal influences on her life.
 
• The memoir is published by **Hamish Hamilton** (an imprint of **Penguin Books**) and is expected to be released simultaneously in **India**, the **UK**, the **USA**, and several other countries.
